findings.one_line: The lift differentiates the identified density in conditional L1 and then asserts the factor-score decomposition (89), hence N_B s_c=h^T u in (90), without deriving factorwise DQM/L2 scores from an arbitrary observed DQM path; this is precisely the missing tangent-closure step, so the claimed bounded lift is not discharged.

After the stated block congruence, (27) must read rank(G_j^aug)=rank(G)+1{e_0-b^T G^+b>0}, not rank(G) times the indicator; as written it gives rank zero when the residual vanishes and does not prove the claimed rank-increase equivalence.

R_Sigma=o_P(1) and Delta_n=o_P(n^{-1/2}) are estimator-determined composite bounds, not consequences of the model assumptions; the sole proposed primitive spline route is explicitly unresolved in oeq:2-coherent-fit-rates, so discharge that route or explicitly maintain/rescope the inference result to a verified rate regime.
